narrNote: WASH is listed as Wisconsin's affiliate on NARR's official affiliates page (narronline.org/affiliates) and states the affiliation on its own homepage. Verified in-run 2026-10-22. Separately, Wisconsin DHS maintains its own Recovery Residence Registry; registry listing is not NARR certification.
notes: Substance use services sit in DHS's Division of Care and Treatment Services; no agency phone was published on the pages verified in-run, so agency.phone is null. The Wisconsin Addiction Recovery Helpline is funded by DHS and operated by 211 Wisconsin (call 211 or 833-944-4673, text ZIP code to 898211, search/chat at addictionhelpwi.org). The 211wisconsin.org root presents a CommunityOS sign-in interstitial to automated fetches; the service and its domain are confirmed in Wisconsin DHS/DWD official publications. ForwardHealth (Wisconsin Medicaid) covers the SUD continuum — outpatient, intensive outpatient, day treatment, residential, and narcotic treatment services — per the ForwardHealth provider handbook pages linked. Wisconsin's local layer is the 72 county human services departments; DHS publishes a community substance use provider directory through its Division of Quality Assurance provider pages rather than one county directory page, so countyDirectory is null — residents reach county services fastest via 211 Wisconsin or the Addiction Recovery Helpline.
